blocks.zh: 附錄：技術移轉案例研究
blocks.en: Appendix: Technology Transfer Case Studies

blocks.zh: Section Overview — 章節概覽
blocks.en: Section Overview

blocks.zh: 本附錄包含12個真實案例，說明TR65技術移轉流程的實際運用。每個案例均標示產品生命週期階段、TT流程階段與場地類型，涵蓋成功最佳實務與失敗警示，主題包括治理架構、團隊組建、法規策略、知識移轉、製程適配、商業化準備、所有權變更、PQ失敗、有效KT、階段關卡與移交。
blocks.en: This appendix contains 12 real-world cases that illustrate how the TR65 technology transfer process is applied in practice. Each case is labeled with its product lifecycle stage, TT process stage and site type, and covers both successful best practices and cautionary failures. Topics include governance structure, team composition, regulatory strategy, knowledge transfer, process fit, commercialization readiness, ownership change, PQ failure, effective KT, stage gates and handover.

blocks.zh: Case Studies — 案例索引
blocks.en: Case Studies

blocks.zh: 引言解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting the Introduction

blocks.zh: 如何閱讀這12個案例
blocks.en: How to Read the 12 Cases

blocks.zh: 每個案例都有三個標籤：產品生命週期階段（開發→商業化 / 商業→商業）、TT流程階段（啟動/規劃/知識移轉/就緒/執行/移交）、場地類型（內部-內部/內部-外部/外部-外部）。
blocks.en: Each case carries three labels: product lifecycle stage (development → commercial / commercial → commercial), TT process stage (initiation / planning / knowledge transfer / readiness / execution / handover) and site type (internal-internal / internal-external / external-external).

blocks.zh: 閱讀時先看標籤，再找與你當前TT最類似的案例深入研究。失敗案例（8.9、8.12）與成功案例同等重要——它們指出最常被忽略的風險點。
blocks.en: Start with the labels, then study in depth the case most similar to your current TT. The failure cases (8.9, 8.12) are just as important as the successes, because they point to the risks most often overlooked.

blocks.zh: 重要提示
blocks.en: Important Note

blocks.zh: 案例中引用的具體法規可能已更新。執行任何TT活動前，務必查閱現行有效的法規版本。
blocks.en: The specific regulations cited in the cases may have been updated since. Before carrying out any TT activity, always consult the current effective version of the regulations.

blocks.zh: TT章程、治理架構與溝通計畫
blocks.en: TT Charter, Governance Structure and Communication Plan

blocks.zh: 解讀與應用
blocks.en: Interpretation and Application

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：治理架構是TT的護欄
blocks.en: Key Lesson: Governance Is the Guardrail of a TT

blocks.zh: 本案例的核心問題是：委託方（Company A）不斷改變需求，而接收方（Company B）缺乏正式機制來管控這些變更的影響。治理架構的缺失讓TT陷入被動應變的循環。
blocks.en: The core problem in this case was that the sending party (Company A) kept changing its requirements, while the receiving party (Company B) had no formal mechanism to control the impact of those changes. Without a governance structure, the TT fell into a cycle of reactive firefighting.

blocks.zh: 解決方案的三個層次：
blocks.en: The solution worked on three levels:

blocks.zh: 操作層：工作流每週會議 + 視覺化追蹤工具
blocks.en: Operational level: weekly workstream meetings plus visual tracking tools

blocks.zh: 管理層：跨職能每週進度會議 + TT PM協調
blocks.en: Management level: weekly cross-functional progress meetings, coordinated by the TT PM

blocks.zh: 決策層：指導委員會每週會議 + 高階管理月會 + 季度面對面
blocks.en: Decision level: weekly steering committee meetings, monthly senior management meetings and quarterly face-to-face meetings

blocks.zh: 比喻：建案與甲方管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Construction Projects and Client Management

blocks.zh: 就像建商承接15棟同時施工的房子，甲方卻不斷改圖。沒有正式的變更管理流程，工人只能跑來跑去應付臨時指令，最後什麼都蓋不完。TT Charter就是「施工合約」——明確定義什麼可以變、如何變、誰來批准。
blocks.en: Imagine a builder constructing 15 houses at once while the client keeps changing the drawings. Without a formal change management process, the workers run around chasing ad hoc instructions and nothing ever gets finished. The TT Charter is the "construction contract": it defines what can change, how it can change and who approves it.

blocks.zh: 成功/失敗的關鍵轉折點
blocks.en: Turning Point Between Failure and Success

blocks.zh: 失敗前：無TT章程、無治理結構、委託方隨意更改需求 → 無法達成時程
blocks.en: Before (failure): no TT charter, no governance structure, the sending party changed requirements at will → the timeline could not be met

blocks.zh: 成功後：建立三層治理架構、制定溝通計畫 → 變更請求大幅減少、KT得以完成
blocks.en: After (success): a three-tier governance structure and a communication plan were established → change requests dropped sharply and KT was completed

blocks.zh: 兩個風險事件（供應商延遲、共用設備衝突）因有指導委員會快速介入而化解，說明治理架構在危機管理中的實際價值。
blocks.en: Two risk events (a supplier delay and a shared-equipment conflict) were resolved through rapid intervention by the steering committee, which shows the practical value of governance in crisis management.

blocks.zh: CDMO承接端應用
blocks.en: Application at the CDMO Receiving Site

blocks.zh: 在TT啟動（Initiation）階段，要求委託方共同簽署TT Charter，明確：
blocks.en: At the TT Initiation stage, require the sending party to co-sign the TT Charter, which should clearly define:

blocks.zh: 變更管理流程：任何知識需求變更必須經過正式評估與批准
blocks.en: Change management process: any change to knowledge requirements must go through formal assessment and approval

blocks.zh: 指導委員會的組成與會議頻率
blocks.en: Composition and meeting frequency of the steering committee

blocks.zh: 溝通計畫：誰對誰報告、多久一次、用什麼工具
blocks.en: Communication plan: who reports to whom, how often and with what tools

blocks.zh: 範圍鎖定（Scope Freeze）的里程碑節點
blocks.en: Milestones for scope freeze

blocks.zh: 承接端關鍵學習
blocks.en: Key Learning for the Receiving Site

blocks.zh: 不要在沒有TT章程的情況下承接多產品組合移轉。「先做再說」的代價是：無止境的變更請求吞噬資源，最終誰都無法達標。將治理架構的建立視為TT的第一個可交付成果。
blocks.en: Do not accept a multi-product portfolio transfer without a TT charter. The price of "just start and sort it out later" is an endless stream of change requests that consume resources until nobody can hit their targets. Treat establishing the governance structure as the first deliverable of the TT.

blocks.zh: 選擇正確的團隊以確保技術移轉成功
blocks.en: Selecting the Right Team to Ensure Technology Transfer Success

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：MAH與CMO的功能對稱原則
blocks.en: Key Lesson: The Principle of Functional Symmetry Between MAH and CMO

blocks.zh: TT成功的人員配置原則：委託方（SU/MAH）每個職能，都應有接收方（RU/CMO）對應的職能鏡像。當委託方只有2人（QA + Supply），而CMO有7個職能的專職人員，資訊不對稱導致CMO必須代為決策——這是TT的重大風險。
blocks.en: Staffing principle for TT success: every function on the sending unit (SU/MAH) side should be mirrored by a corresponding function on the receiving unit (RU/CMO) side. When the sending party had only 2 people (QA + Supply) while the CMO had dedicated staff in 7 functions, the information asymmetry forced the CMO to make decisions on its behalf, which is a major TT risk.

blocks.zh: 對等職能配置：PM ↔ PM、QA ↔ QA、驗證 ↔ 驗證、製程工程 ↔ 製程工程、分析 ↔ 分析
blocks.en: Matched functional staffing: PM ↔ PM, QA ↔ QA, validation ↔ validation, process engineering ↔ process engineering, analytical ↔ analytical

blocks.zh: 比喻：足球比賽缺少後衛
blocks.en: Analogy: A Football Match Without Defenders

blocks.zh: 就像一隊只派前鋒上場，另一隊卻有完整的11人陣容。前者贏了球（CMO做了決定），但輸了比賽的控制權（委託方喪失對產品的掌握）。TT中，委託方缺乏功能性SME，等於把自己的產品知識完全外包給CMO。
blocks.en: It is like one team fielding only forwards while the other has a full squad of 11. The first team scores a goal (the CMO made a decision) but loses control of the match (the sending party loses its grip on its own product). In a TT, a sending party without functional SMEs has effectively outsourced all of its product knowledge to the CMO.

blocks.zh: 成功的關鍵轉折
blocks.en: Key Turning Point for Success

blocks.zh: Company A在Readiness階段才補齊人員——雖然比理想時間晚，但依然有效。說明：即使TT已經啟動，補強人員永遠不嫌晚。最糟糕的做法是發現問題卻繼續硬撐，直到PQ失敗才補救。
blocks.en: Company A filled out its staffing only at the Readiness stage. This was later than ideal but still effective. The lesson: even after the TT has started, it is never too late to reinforce the team. The worst approach is to see the problem and push on regardless until a PQ failure forces a remedy.

blocks.zh: 在Initiation階段的Kick-off Meeting前，要求委託方提供組織架構圖，確認其TT Team涵蓋以下職能：
blocks.en: Before the kick-off meeting in the Initiation stage, ask the sending party for an organization chart and confirm that its TT team covers the following functions:

blocks.zh: Project Manager（TT決策窗口）
blocks.en: Project Manager (TT decision-making contact)

blocks.zh: Quality（批准文件、偏差）
blocks.en: Quality (document approval, deviations)

blocks.zh: Regulatory（法規策略與申報）
blocks.en: Regulatory (regulatory strategy and filings)

blocks.zh: Process/CMC（製程知識持有者）
blocks.en: Process/CMC (holders of process knowledge)

blocks.zh: Analytical（方法移轉）
blocks.en: Analytical (method transfer)

blocks.zh: Supply Chain（物料來源）
blocks.en: Supply Chain (material sourcing)

blocks.zh: 若委託方人員不足，在TT Charter中明確記錄此風險，並協商補足的時程。
blocks.en: If the sending party is short of staff, document this risk explicitly in the TT Charter and negotiate a timeline for filling the gaps.

blocks.zh: CDMO不應承擔委託方應負責的決策。若委託方持續缺席決策，這是一個早期警訊，預示TT後期的知識移轉缺口與監管風險。主動要求委託方補齊對應人員，比事後補救更省資源。
blocks.en: A CDMO should not take on decisions that belong to the sending party. If the sending party is persistently absent from decision-making, this is an early warning of knowledge transfer gaps and regulatory risk later in the TT. Proactively asking the sending party to fill the matching roles costs fewer resources than remediation after the fact.

blocks.zh: 啟動與規劃階段對技術移轉的重要性
blocks.en: Importance of Initiation and Planning Stages for Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：「簡單的TT」是最危險的假設
blocks.en: Key Lesson: The "Simple TT" Is the Most Dangerous Assumption

blocks.zh: 本案例的根本錯誤是低估風險。「製程幾乎一樣」的判斷導致：
blocks.en: The fundamental error in this case was underestimating risk. The judgment that "the process is almost the same" led to:

blocks.zh: 預算與時程嚴重低估
blocks.en: Seriously underestimated budget and timeline

blocks.zh: 人員配置不足（兼職 vs. 全職專責）
blocks.en: Inadequate staffing (part-time versus dedicated full-time)

blocks.zh: 未執行風險評估（設備型號差異被忽略）
blocks.en: No risk assessment (differences in equipment models were ignored)

blocks.zh: 未執行差距評估（gap assessment）
blocks.en: No gap assessment

blocks.zh: SU端資源不足，KT不完整
blocks.en: Insufficient SU resources and incomplete KT

blocks.zh: 結果：RU完全依賴SU的持續支援，製程驗證無法獨立進行。
blocks.en: Result: the RU depended entirely on continued SU support, and process validation could not be performed independently.

blocks.zh: 比喻：「複製貼上」的程式碼
blocks.en: Analogy: "Copy-and-Paste" Code

blocks.zh: 就像程式設計師認為「複製一份程式碼就能在新環境跑」，卻忘了作業系統版本不同、程式庫版本不同。表面上程式碼一樣，但底層環境的差異讓它無法正常運作。TT中，「設備幾乎一樣」不等於「製程會一樣運作」。
blocks.en: It is like a programmer who assumes that copying a piece of code will run in a new environment, forgetting that the operating system version and library versions differ. The code looks identical, but differences in the underlying environment stop it from working properly. In a TT, "nearly identical equipment" does not mean "the process will behave the same way".

blocks.zh: 三個被跳過的必要步驟
blocks.en: Three Essential Steps That Were Skipped

blocks.zh: 風險評估：即使是「微小」的設備差異，也必須進行正式風險評估
blocks.en: Risk assessment: even "minor" equipment differences require a formal risk assessment

blocks.zh: 差距評估（Gap Assessment）：任何TT都應評估SU製程在RU環境的適配性
blocks.en: Gap assessment: every TT should assess the fit of the SU process in the RU environment

blocks.zh: SU資源配置：送出方（SU）同樣需要專職資源支援KT，不能只靠接收方
blocks.en: SU resource allocation: the sending unit (SU) also needs dedicated resources to support KT; it cannot rely on the receiving party alone

blocks.zh: 無論委託方說這個TT「有多簡單」，承接端必須堅持執行以下評估：
blocks.en: No matter how "simple" the sending party says the TT is, the receiving site must insist on performing the following assessments:

blocks.zh: 設備等同性評估（Equipment Equivalence Assessment）
blocks.en: Equipment equivalence assessment

blocks.zh: 製程差距評估（Process Gap Assessment）
blocks.en: Process gap assessment

blocks.zh: 法規影響評估（Regulatory Impact Assessment）
blocks.en: Regulatory impact assessment

blocks.zh: 完整的TT風險矩陣
blocks.en: A complete TT risk matrix

blocks.zh: 在TT Charter中明確寫入這些評估的執行義務，並要求SU提供專職的技術支援資源。
blocks.en: Write the obligation to perform these assessments explicitly into the TT Charter, and require the SU to provide dedicated technical support resources.

blocks.zh: 內部TT（同公司不同廠區）的失敗率不低於外部TT。承接端應警惕：當委託方以「內部移轉」為由簡化流程時，這往往是最容易被忽視的風險來源。堅持完整的TT流程，不因「關係熟」而妥協。
blocks.en: Internal TTs (same company, different sites) fail at no lower a rate than external TTs. The receiving site should be wary: when the sending party simplifies the process on the grounds that it is an "internal transfer", this is often the most easily overlooked source of risk. Insist on the full TT process and do not compromise because "we know each other well".

blocks.zh: 在啟動階段運用法規策略做出決策
blocks.en: Using Regulatory Strategy to Make Decisions at the Initiation Stage

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：法規複雜性決定CMO選擇空間
blocks.en: Key Lesson: Regulatory Complexity Determines the CMO Options

blocks.zh: 本案例展示了法規策略如何在Initiation階段就決定TT的走向：
blocks.en: This case shows how regulatory strategy can determine the direction of a TT as early as the Initiation stage:

blocks.zh: 產品類型（獸藥，無人用適應症）觸發ANVISA特殊要求
blocks.en: The product type (a veterinary drug with no human indication) triggered special ANVISA requirements

blocks.zh: ANVISA要求獨立生產線 → 大幅縮小可選CMO範圍
blocks.en: ANVISA required a dedicated production line → this greatly narrowed the pool of eligible CMOs

blocks.zh: 最終選擇比競爭對手多6個月的CMO F → 因為其時程估算更真實
blocks.en: The company finally chose CMO F, whose timeline was 6 months longer than its competitor's, because its time estimate was more realistic

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：較長但真實的時程，優於較短但不切實際的時程。
blocks.en: Key principle: a longer but realistic timeline is better than a shorter but unrealistic one.

blocks.zh: 比喻：選承包商的智慧
blocks.en: Analogy: The Wisdom of Choosing a Contractor

blocks.zh: 找人裝修時，報價最低、工期最短的通常不是最好的選擇。有經驗的師傅會列出所有需要做的細項，解釋為什麼需要那麼多時間——這反而是信任的象徵。CMO E的6個月時程差距，不是效率優勢，而是對複雜性的低估。
blocks.en: When hiring someone for a renovation, the lowest quote and shortest schedule are usually not the best choice. An experienced contractor lists every task involved and explains why it takes so long, which is itself a sign of trustworthiness. The 6-month timeline gap of CMO E was not an efficiency advantage; it reflected an underestimation of complexity.

blocks.zh: CMO評選的多維度框架
blocks.en: A Multi-Dimensional Framework for CMO Selection

blocks.zh: 本案例展示了完整的CMO評選標準：
blocks.en: This case shows a complete set of CMO selection criteria:

blocks.zh: 品質體系與文件化能力
blocks.en: Quality system and documentation capability

blocks.zh: 凍乾製造的專業能力與經驗
blocks.en: Lyophilization manufacturing expertise and experience

blocks.zh: 設備等同性
blocks.en: Equipment equivalence

blocks.zh: 分析能力（放行與穩定性）
blocks.en: Analytical capability (release and stability)

blocks.zh: 成本
blocks.en: Cost

blocks.zh: 預估商業化時程（真實性比長短更重要）
blocks.en: Estimated commercialization timeline (realism matters more than length)

blocks.zh: 法規合規性（多市場的特殊要求）
blocks.en: Regulatory compliance (special requirements of multiple markets)

blocks.zh: 在提供TT時程估算時：
blocks.en: When providing a TT timeline estimate:

blocks.zh: 寧願給出真實的較長時程，也不要用「樂觀估算」贏得合同
blocks.en: Give a realistic longer timeline rather than winning the contract with an "optimistic estimate"

blocks.zh: 主動識別所有法規複雜性（多市場要求、特殊法規限制），並在時程中體現
blocks.en: Proactively identify all regulatory complexities (multi-market requirements, special regulatory restrictions) and reflect them in the timeline

blocks.zh: 建立詳細的時程說明文件，讓委託方理解每個里程碑背後的工作量
blocks.en: Prepare detailed timeline documentation so that the sending party understands the workload behind each milestone

blocks.zh: 真實的時程是建立信任的基礎，也是避免後期衝突的最佳保障。
blocks.en: A realistic timeline is the foundation of trust and the best safeguard against later conflict.

blocks.zh: 在評估TT可行性時，必須將目標市場的所有法規要求納入Initiation階段的考量。特別是多市場產品，不同監管機構的要求可能直接影響廠房佈局、設備配置、人員要求——這些都是TT時程與成本的重要驅動因素。
blocks.en: When assessing TT feasibility, all regulatory requirements of the target markets must be taken into account at the Initiation stage. For multi-market products in particular, the requirements of different regulatory authorities can directly affect facility layout, equipment configuration and staffing, and these are all major drivers of TT timeline and cost.

blocks.zh: 知識移轉以確保製程確效成功
blocks.en: Knowledge Transfer to Ensure Process Validation Success

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：成熟的CMO從失敗中學習並系統化
blocks.en: Key Lesson: A Mature CMO Learns from Failure and Systematizes

blocks.zh: Company B的優勢在於：將過去的失敗教訓轉化為可複製的TT工具與流程。這是CMO成熟度的標誌。其KT工具組包含：
blocks.en: Company B's strength is that it turned lessons from past failures into repeatable TT tools and processes, which is a hallmark of CMO maturity. Its KT toolkit includes:

blocks.zh: 移交表格與核查清單（範疇、邊界、目標）
blocks.en: Handover forms and checklists (scope, boundaries, objectives)

blocks.zh: KT Playbook（客戶期望、下一步驟、所需數據）
blocks.en: KT Playbook (customer expectations, next steps, required data)

blocks.zh: Pre-kickoff職能分組虛擬會議
blocks.en: Virtual function-based pre-kickoff meetings

blocks.zh: Face-to-face正式Kick-off
blocks.en: Formal face-to-face kick-off

blocks.zh: 技術風險評估 + 追蹤工具
blocks.en: Technical risk assessment plus tracking tool

blocks.zh: 現場隱性知識捕捉（on-the-floor tacit KT）
blocks.en: On-the-floor tacit knowledge capture (on-the-floor tacit KT)

blocks.zh: 比喻：Playbook的力量
blocks.en: Analogy: The Power of a Playbook

blocks.zh: 頂尖廚師在新廚師加入時，不是說「跟著我做」，而是給一本詳細的食譜手冊，包含每個步驟的注意事項與常見錯誤。Company B的KT Playbook就是這個角色——讓即使第一次商業化的客戶（Company A），也能快速理解CMO需要什麼，並提前準備好。
blocks.en: When a new chef joins, a top chef does not just say "follow me"; he hands over a detailed recipe manual that lists the points to watch and the common mistakes at every step. Company B's KT Playbook plays this role: even a customer commercializing for the first time (Company A) can quickly understand what the CMO needs and prepare in advance.

blocks.zh: 隱性知識的捕捉是關鍵
blocks.en: Capturing Tacit Knowledge Is Critical

blocks.zh: 本案例特別強調「on-the-floor support」——讓Company A的關鍵專家在製程進行時到場，直接捕捉隱性知識（tacit knowledge）。這種知識無法只靠文件傳遞：操作手感、判斷時機、異常識別——都需要在現場、面對面地傳承。
blocks.en: This case particularly stresses "on-the-floor support": having Company A's key experts present while the process runs, so that they directly capture tacit knowledge. This kind of knowledge cannot be passed on through documents alone. Hands-on feel, timing of judgments and recognition of abnormalities must all be handed over on site and face to face.

blocks.zh: 特別是在開發人員交棒給商業生產人員的環節，這個現場知識捕捉尤為重要。
blocks.en: This on-site knowledge capture is especially important at the point where development staff hand over to commercial production staff.

blocks.zh: 建立並持續優化你的KT工具組：
blocks.en: Build and continuously improve your KT toolkit:

blocks.zh: 為新客戶準備標準化的KT Questionnaire（涵蓋製程、分析、法規、物料）
blocks.en: Prepare a standardized KT Questionnaire for new customers (covering process, analytical, regulatory and materials)

blocks.zh: 設計Pre-kickoff的職能分組會議流程
blocks.en: Design the workflow for pre-kickoff function-based meetings

blocks.zh: 建立TT Risk Tracking工具（追蹤所有KT風險與緩解措施）
blocks.en: Establish a TT Risk Tracking tool (tracking all KT risks and mitigation measures)

blocks.zh: 在執行階段安排委託方SME到場（on-floor），捕捉隱性知識
blocks.en: Arrange for the sending party's SMEs to be on the floor during the execution stage to capture tacit knowledge

blocks.zh: 在開發→商業生產的交棒節點，重複執行KT確認
blocks.en: Repeat KT confirmation at the development → commercial production handover point

blocks.zh: TT的按時完成，不是靠運氣，而是靠系統性的KT工具與透明溝通。投資建立可複製的KT Playbook，是CDMO提升TT成功率的最高槓桿點之一。每次TT後的教訓都應被整合回Playbook，讓組織不斷進化。
blocks.en: On-time TT completion comes not from luck but from systematic KT tools and transparent communication. Investing in a repeatable KT Playbook is one of the highest-leverage ways for a CDMO to raise its TT success rate. Lessons from every TT should be fed back into the Playbook so that the organization keeps evolving.

blocks.zh: 執行製程適配評估以促進技術移轉
blocks.en: Performing a Process Fit Assessment to Facilitate Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：製程適配評估是兩階段迭代過程
blocks.en: Key Lesson: Process Fit Assessment Is a Two-Stage Iterative Process

blocks.zh: 本案例示範了Process Fit Assessment的最佳實踐：
blocks.en: This case demonstrates best practice for the Process Fit Assessment:

blocks.zh: 第一次（Initiation階段）：基於初步需求的概略評估 → 指導設備規格方向
blocks.en: First pass (Initiation stage): a high-level assessment based on preliminary requirements → guides the direction of equipment specifications

blocks.zh: 第二次（Knowledge Transfer階段）：基於完整產率數據的詳細評估 → 精確設備採購與製程開發計畫
blocks.en: Second pass (Knowledge Transfer stage): a detailed assessment based on complete yield data → precise equipment procurement and process development plan

blocks.zh: 評估內容涵蓋：成分添加量、流速、容器最大/最小容積、質量平衡參數、停留時間、混合時間。
blocks.en: The assessment covers: component addition amounts, flow rates, maximum/minimum container volumes, mass balance parameters, hold times and mixing times.

blocks.zh: 比喻：房屋改建的結構評估
blocks.en: Analogy: Structural Assessment for a House Renovation

blocks.zh: 把一個小廚房擴建成商業廚房，不能只看平面圖就決定買什麼設備。第一步是概略評估空間和電力是否足夠；第二步是請結構工程師詳細計算承重、水電配置。少了第二步，買來的設備可能根本裝不進去，或者運作時發現電力不足。Process Fit Assessment就是這個結構評估。
blocks.en: When expanding a small kitchen into a commercial kitchen, you cannot decide what equipment to buy just from the floor plan. The first step is a rough assessment of whether space and electrical capacity are sufficient; the second is to have a structural engineer calculate load-bearing capacity and utilities in detail. Without the second step, the equipment you buy may not fit at all, or you may discover insufficient power once it is running. The Process Fit Assessment is this structural assessment.

blocks.zh: 多價疫苗的特殊複雜性
blocks.en: Special Complexity of Multivalent Vaccines

blocks.zh: Product Alpha是多價疫苗，不同血清型（serotype）對同一單元操作的體積需求不同。工程師的解決方案是「最大最小體積分組」——以最少設備涵蓋所有情況。這個思路展示了process fit assessment在多產品共用設備場景下的實際應用。
blocks.en: Product Alpha is a multivalent vaccine, and different serotypes have different volume requirements for the same unit operation. The engineers' solution was "maximum/minimum volume grouping", covering all cases with the least equipment. This approach shows the practical application of process fit assessment in a shared-equipment, multi-product scenario.

blocks.zh: 在Initiation階段，要求委託方提供足夠的製程數據以執行初步Fit Assessment：
blocks.en: At the Initiation stage, require the sending party to provide enough process data to perform a preliminary Fit Assessment:

blocks.zh: 批次大小範圍（最大/最小/典型）
blocks.en: Batch size range (maximum/minimum/typical)

blocks.zh: 關鍵單元操作的體積/流量需求
blocks.en: Volume/flow requirements of key unit operations

blocks.zh: 放大比例（pilot-to-commercial scale-up factor）
blocks.en: Scale-up factor (pilot-to-commercial scale-up factor)

blocks.zh: 混合、停留時間等關鍵製程參數
blocks.en: Critical process parameters such as mixing and hold times

blocks.zh: 在KT階段，用實際產率數據更新Fit Assessment，並識別需要額外製程開發的領域。放大過程中的混合效率（如CFD模擬）可能需要額外的開發工作，應在KT Risk Assessment中體現。
blocks.en: At the KT stage, update the Fit Assessment with actual yield data and identify areas that need additional process development. Mixing efficiency during scale-up (for example, by CFD simulation) may require additional development work, which should be reflected in the KT Risk Assessment.

blocks.zh: Process Fit Assessment不是一次性活動，而是隨TT進展持續更新的動態文件。Initiation階段的初步評估決定設備採購方向；KT階段的詳細評估決定製程開發需求。兩次評估之間的差距，往往是TT風險的主要來源。
blocks.en: The Process Fit Assessment is not a one-off activity but a dynamic document that is updated as the TT progresses. The preliminary assessment at the Initiation stage determines the direction of equipment procurement; the detailed assessment at the KT stage determines process development needs. The gap between the two assessments is often the main source of TT risk.

blocks.zh: 提前規劃以實現準時商業上市
blocks.en: Planning Ahead to Achieve On-Time Commercial Launch

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：商業化準備從TT第一天就開始
blocks.en: Key Lesson: Commercialization Readiness Starts on Day One of the TT

blocks.zh: 本案例展示了全程TT（Initiation到Handover）的整合規劃。關鍵成功要素：
blocks.en: This case shows integrated planning across the whole TT (Initiation to Handover). Key success factors:

blocks.zh: 以「NDA簽署後立即啟動TT Team擴充」作為觸發點
blocks.en: Using "expanding the TT Team immediately after NDA signature" as the trigger point

blocks.zh: RU TT Team持續更新18個月商業化預測
blocks.en: The RU TT Team continuously updating the 18-month commercial forecast

blocks.zh: Handover會議頻率隨商業生產日期接近而升高
blocks.en: Handover meeting frequency increasing as the commercial production date approaches

blocks.zh: 備件與物料需求在Handover前完成設置
blocks.en: Spare parts and material requirements set up before Handover

blocks.zh: 正式移交給Post-transfer Operations Team
blocks.en: Formal handover to the Post-transfer Operations Team

blocks.zh: 比喻：飛機著陸的進場程序
blocks.en: Analogy: The Approach Procedure for Landing an Aircraft

blocks.zh: 飛機不是到了跑道上方才開始降落準備。進場程序在20海里外就開始：速度控制、高度調整、與塔台通訊、放下起落架……商業上市的準備也是如此：供應商Lead Time管理、操作員訓練、ERP系統設定——都必須在上市前數個月完成，而不是在TT結束後才啟動。
blocks.en: A pilot does not start landing preparations only when over the runway. The approach procedure begins 20 nautical miles out: speed control, altitude adjustment, communication with the tower, lowering the landing gear and so on. Commercial launch preparation is the same: supplier lead time management, operator training and ERP system setup must all be completed months before launch, not started after the TT ends.

blocks.zh: Handover清單的關鍵要素
blocks.en: Key Elements of the Handover Checklist

blocks.zh: 所有來自TT的Lessons Learned已整合進Batch Record
blocks.en: All lessons learned from the TT have been incorporated into the batch record

blocks.zh: 關鍵供應商聯絡人已正式介紹給商業生產團隊
blocks.en: Key supplier contacts have been formally introduced to the commercial production team

blocks.zh: 物料與批次管理系統（ERP/SAP）已完成設定
blocks.en: Material and batch management systems (ERP/SAP) have been set up

blocks.zh: 備件庫存已按18個月預測備齊
blocks.en: Spare parts inventory has been stocked according to the 18-month forecast

blocks.zh: 操作員訓練已完成並記錄
blocks.en: Operator training has been completed and documented

blocks.zh: 生產排程已整合資源需求與設備能力
blocks.en: The production schedule integrates resource needs and equipment capacity

blocks.zh: 在TT項目計畫中，將以下商業化準備活動明確設為里程碑：
blocks.en: In the TT project plan, set the following commercialization readiness activities explicitly as milestones:

blocks.zh: T-6個月：完成供應商資格確認，Lock住主要物料來源
blocks.en: T-6 months: complete supplier qualification and lock in the main material sources

blocks.zh: T-4個月：ERP/SAP物料主檔建立完成
blocks.en: T-4 months: complete creation of ERP/SAP material master data

blocks.zh: T-3個月：操作員訓練計畫啟動
blocks.en: T-3 months: start the operator training program

blocks.zh: T-2個月：備件庫存到位
blocks.en: T-2 months: spare parts inventory in place

blocks.zh: T-1個月：Handover會議由週一次升為每週多次
blocks.en: T-1 month: Handover meetings increase from once a week to several times a week

blocks.zh: T-0：正式移交Post-transfer Operations Team
blocks.en: T-0: formal handover to the Post-transfer Operations Team

blocks.zh: TT成功不等於商業化成功。TT Team的最終任務是確保接手的Operations Team具備足夠的知識、工具與資源，能夠在沒有TT Team支援的情況下獨立運作。Handover是TT的最後也是最重要的品質關卡。
blocks.en: TT success does not equal commercialization success. The final task of the TT Team is to ensure that the receiving Operations Team has sufficient knowledge, tools and resources to operate independently without TT Team support. Handover is the last and most important quality gate of the TT.

blocks.zh: 在藥品移轉過程中應對製程、資本與所有權變更
blocks.en: Managing Process, Capital and Ownership Changes During Pharmaceutical Transfer

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：虛擬公司的TT特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Key Lesson: Special TT Challenges for Virtual Companies

blocks.zh: 本案例涵蓋兩個在CDMO業界高度相關的教訓：
blocks.en: This case covers two lessons highly relevant to the CDMO industry:

blocks.zh: 教訓1（資本責任）：追加設備採購的費用分攤必須在TT啟動時談妥，而非等到問題發生後才協商
blocks.en: Lesson 1 (capital responsibility): the cost-sharing for additional equipment purchases must be agreed at TT initiation, not negotiated after problems arise

blocks.zh: 教訓2（文件所有權）：MAH必須確保自己擁有方法、批次記錄等關鍵文件的所有權——在與Company A的合約中就應明確，否則從A移轉至B時會遭遇重大阻礙
blocks.en: Lesson 2 (document ownership): the MAH must make sure it owns key documents such as methods and batch records. This should be made explicit in the contract with Company A; otherwise major obstacles arise when transferring from A to B

blocks.zh: 比喻：租房搬家前確認財產歸屬
blocks.en: Analogy: Confirming Ownership Before Moving Out of a Rental

blocks.zh: 租客搬出時，房東才說「你裝修加的那面牆是我的，不能拆走」。同理，MAH在結束與Company A的合約時，才發現批次記錄的所有權沒有事先約定——這是合約管理的重大失誤。TT就像一場搬家：在搬之前，必須確認哪些東西是你的，哪些是房東的，哪些需要特別授權才能帶走。
blocks.en: When a tenant moves out, the landlord says, "The wall you added in the renovation belongs to me, and you can't take it away." Similarly, the MAH discovered only when ending its contract with Company A that ownership of the batch records had not been agreed beforehand, which is a serious contract management failure. A TT is like moving house: before the move, you must confirm which things are yours, which belong to the landlord and which need special authorization before you can take them.

blocks.zh: 保密性帶來的複雜性
blocks.en: Complexity Created by Confidentiality

blocks.zh: 本案例另一個值得關注的面向：MAH不希望Company A知道正在轉移到Company B，因此禁止兩家CMO直接溝通。這意味著MAH必須作為中間層傳遞所有技術信息——增加了溝通複雜性與KT的時間成本。
blocks.en: Another noteworthy aspect of this case: the MAH did not want Company A to know that the product was being transferred to Company B, so direct communication between the two CMOs was prohibited. This meant the MAH had to act as an intermediary for all technical information, which increased communication complexity and the time cost of KT.

blocks.zh: 現實中，CDMO常遇到這類「保密TT」情境，需要提前在KT計畫中建立對應的溝通機制。
blocks.en: In practice, CDMOs often encounter such "confidential TT" scenarios and need to establish appropriate communication mechanisms in the KT plan in advance.

blocks.zh: 在TT合約談判時，主動確認以下條款：
blocks.en: During TT contract negotiation, proactively confirm the following terms:

blocks.zh: 文件所有權：明確列明哪些文件（分析方法、批次記錄、驗證報告）的所有權屬於委託方，且可在TT結束後轉移使用
blocks.en: Document ownership: state clearly which documents (analytical methods, batch records, validation reports) are owned by the sending party and can be transferred for use after the TT ends

blocks.zh: 追加資本責任：明確約定因製程變更或設備升級產生的追加資本投入由誰負責
blocks.en: Additional capital responsibility: agree explicitly who is responsible for additional capital expenditure arising from process changes or equipment upgrades

blocks.zh: 放大策略：若TT涉及規模放大，必須在Planning階段確認驗證批次數量與策略
blocks.en: Scale-up strategy: if the TT involves scale-up, the number of validation batches and the strategy must be confirmed at the Planning stage

blocks.zh: TT合約的細節決定TT的成敗。文件所有權、追加資本分攤、機密條款的溝通限制——這些看似法務問題，實際上直接影響技術移轉的執行效率。在Initiation階段投入足夠的法律與商務資源審視合約，是CDMO自我保護的第一道防線。
blocks.en: The details of the TT contract determine the success or failure of the TT. Document ownership, sharing of additional capital and communication restrictions under confidentiality clauses may look like legal issues, but they directly affect the efficiency of technical transfer execution. Investing enough legal and commercial resources in reviewing the contract at the Initiation stage is a CDMO's first line of self-protection.

blocks.zh: 因製程就緒度與知識移轉不完整導致製程確效失敗
blocks.en: Process Validation Failure Due to Process Readiness and Incomplete Knowledge Transfer

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：供應壓力不能凌駕製程就緒度
blocks.en: Key Lesson: Supply Pressure Must Not Override Process Readiness

blocks.zh: 本案例是TR65最重要的警示故事之一。失敗的根本原因：
blocks.en: This case is one of the most important cautionary stories in TR65. The root causes of the failure:

blocks.zh: Engineering run結果次優（suboptimal），但供應壓力迫使提前進入PQ
blocks.en: The engineering run results were suboptimal, but supply pressure forced an early move into PQ

blocks.zh: 委託方與CMO的目標嚴重不一致：供應連續性 vs. 製程品質
blocks.en: The sending party and the CMO had seriously misaligned goals: supply continuity vs. process quality

blocks.zh: 妥協方案（最小化改善後進行PQ）未能解決根本的製程就緒度缺口
blocks.en: The compromise (running PQ after minimal improvements) did not close the underlying process readiness gap

blocks.zh: PQ失敗 → 損失3個月 → 最終延遲6個月，遠超過事先做好改善所需的時間
blocks.en: PQ failure → 3 months lost → a final delay of 6 months, far more than the time needed to make the improvements beforehand

blocks.zh: 比喻：趕時間的外科手術
blocks.en: Analogy: Surgery in a Hurry

blocks.zh: 病患堅持要在血壓異常時立即進行選擇性手術，因為不想再等了。醫生提出風險，病患自行簽署免責聲明，手術台上出了問題。最後花的時間比等到血壓穩定後再手術多了三倍。TT中，在製程就緒度不足時強行進入PQ，是一樣的邏輯陷阱。
blocks.en: A patient insists on elective surgery right away despite abnormal blood pressure, because he does not want to wait any longer. The doctor raises the risks, the patient signs a waiver himself, and something goes wrong on the operating table. In the end it takes three times as long as it would have if he had waited until his blood pressure stabilized. Forcing the TT into PQ when process readiness is insufficient is the same logical trap.

blocks.zh: CMO的正確立場
blocks.en: The CMO's Correct Position

blocks.zh: Company C的立場是正確的：製程就緒度不足時，不應進入PQ。儘管最終做出了妥協，但Company C已明確表達其專業判斷，並要求委託方承擔風險責任。這是CDMO在面對來自委託方的時程壓力時，必須堅守的專業底線。
blocks.en: Company C's position was correct: when process readiness is insufficient, you should not enter PQ. Although it eventually agreed to a compromise, Company C clearly stated its professional judgment and required the sending party to accept responsibility for the risk. This is the professional bottom line a CDMO must hold when facing schedule pressure from a sending party.

blocks.zh: 重要：PQ失敗的3個月損失，加上調整後的計畫執行時間，遠超過事先正確執行製程改善所需的時間。「冒險快跑」反而更慢。
blocks.en: Important: the 3 months lost to the PQ failure, plus the time to execute the revised plan, far exceeded the time it would have taken to carry out the process improvements properly in advance. "Running risky and fast" turned out slower.

blocks.zh: 建立明確的PQ就緒度標準（Readiness Criteria），在TT Charter中約定：
blocks.en: Establish clear PQ readiness criteria and agree them in the TT Charter:

blocks.zh: Engineering run的通過標準必須達到X%以上才能進入PQ
blocks.en: The engineering run acceptance criteria must reach X% or higher before PQ may begin

blocks.zh: 若Engineering run結果次優，有權暫停並要求進行根本原因調查
blocks.en: If the engineering run results are suboptimal, the right to pause and require a root cause investigation

blocks.zh: 時程壓力不得作為跳過就緒度評估的理由
blocks.en: Schedule pressure must not be used as a reason to skip the readiness assessment

blocks.zh: 委託方若堅持在就緒度不足情況下推進，必須以書面承擔相應風險責任
blocks.en: If the sending party insists on proceeding despite insufficient readiness, it must accept the corresponding risk responsibility in writing

blocks.zh: 面對委託方的時程壓力，CDMO最有力的論點是：「現在多花2個月做好，勝過PQ失敗後損失6個月。」用數字說話，而非只是說「我覺得還沒準備好」。建立一套製程就緒度評分體系，讓Go/No-Go決策有客觀依據，不是主觀判斷。
blocks.en: When facing schedule pressure from the sending party, the CDMO's strongest argument is: "Spending 2 more months to get it right now is better than losing 6 months after a PQ failure." Let the numbers speak, rather than just saying "I feel it is not ready yet". Build a process readiness scoring system so that the Go/No-Go decision has an objective basis rather than resting on subjective judgment.

blocks.zh: 有效運用知識移轉
blocks.en: Leveraging Knowledge Transfer Effectively

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：先前TT的知識是下一次TT的資本
blocks.en: Key Lesson: Knowledge from a Previous TT Is Capital for the Next TT

blocks.zh: 本案例最重要的洞察：Company Y因為有mAb-X到Site A的TT經驗，在mAb-X到Site B的TT中取得了顯著優勢：
blocks.en: The most important insight of this case: because Company Y had experience from the mAb-X transfer to Site A, it gained a significant advantage in the mAb-X transfer to Site B:

blocks.zh: 製程參數分類（已完成）→ 直接作為新TT起點
blocks.en: Process parameter classification (completed) → used directly as the starting point of the new TT

blocks.zh: 風險評估（已完成）→ 在Site A基礎上更新，而非從零開始
blocks.en: Risk assessment (completed) → updated on the Site A basis rather than started from scratch

blocks.zh: 分析方法（已移轉）→ Site B的方法移轉以Site A為模板
blocks.en: Analytical methods (transferred) → the method transfer to Site B used Site A as the template

blocks.zh: 製程描述文件（已建立）→ Site B版本以Site A版本為模板修改
blocks.en: Process description document (established) → the Site B version was modified from the Site A version as a template

blocks.zh: 這說明：每次TT都是下一次TT的知識投資。
blocks.en: This shows that every TT is a knowledge investment for the next TT.

blocks.zh: 比喻：連鎖店的開店SOP
blocks.en: Analogy: The Store-Opening SOP of a Chain

blocks.zh: 第一家門市開業很痛苦，所有流程都要摸索。第二家、第三家就快多了——因為有了標準化的開店手冊。Company Y的第二次TT之所以順利，正是因為它把第一次TT的痛苦轉化成了可複用的制度性知識。
blocks.en: Opening the first store is painful because every process has to be worked out by trial and error. The second and third go much faster because there is a standardized store-opening manual. Company Y's second TT went smoothly precisely because it turned the pain of the first TT into reusable institutional knowledge.

blocks.zh: PPQ矩陣策略的實際應用
blocks.en: Practical Application of the PPQ Matrix Strategy

blocks.zh: 本案例描述了PPQ的矩陣策略（matrix approach）：用最小和最大批次大小來bracket，而非每個尺寸都跑完整PPQ。這是ICH Q10和FDA製程驗證指引認可的基於風險的策略，在生物製劑TT中尤為常見。關鍵是策略的事前記錄與批准（documented prior to execution）。
blocks.en: This case describes a matrix approach to PPQ: bracketing with the minimum and maximum batch sizes rather than running a full PPQ at every size. This is a risk-based strategy recognized by ICH Q10 and the FDA process validation guidance, and is especially common in biologics TT. The key is that the strategy is documented and approved prior to execution.

blocks.zh: 建立「TT知識庫」機制：
blocks.en: Establish a "TT knowledge base" mechanism:

blocks.zh: 每次TT結束後，將風險評估、分析方法評估、設備等同性評估歸檔至產品知識庫
blocks.en: After each TT, archive the risk assessment, analytical method assessment and equipment equivalence assessment in the product knowledge base

blocks.zh: 下次接收同類產品或同一委託方的TT時，優先查閱既有評估，在既有基礎上更新
blocks.en: When receiving a TT for a similar product or from the same sending party, first consult existing assessments and update them rather than starting over

blocks.zh: 用「差距評估 vs. 既有知識」取代「從零開始的評估」，大幅縮短KT時間
blocks.en: Replace "assessment from scratch" with "gap assessment against existing knowledge" to greatly shorten KT time

blocks.zh: 同時，要求委託方提供所有既有的TT相關文件（前一個CMO的驗證報告、製程描述等），作為本次TT的起點。
blocks.en: Also require the sending party to provide all existing TT-related documents (the previous CMO's validation reports, process descriptions and so on) as the starting point for this TT.

blocks.zh: Change Control Management System的建立應在TT執行前完成——所有製程、規格、設備、參數的變更都應納入中央變更管控。這是防止「知識碎片化」的制度保障，也是後續監管檢查的核心文件基礎。
blocks.en: A Change Control Management System should be established before TT execution; all changes to processes, specifications, equipment and parameters should come under central change control. This is the institutional safeguard against "knowledge fragmentation" and also the core documentation basis for subsequent regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: 運用階段關卡應對製程就緒度挑戰
blocks.en: Using Stage Gates to Address Process Readiness Challenges

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：Stage Gate是決策升級的結構化機制
blocks.en: Key Lesson: A Stage Gate Is a Structured Mechanism for Decision Escalation

blocks.zh: 本案例與8.9的關鍵差異在於：當TT Team發現目標與現實的落差時，主動建立Stage Gate機制，而非在壓力下做出妥協。Stage Gate的三個功能：
blocks.en: The key difference between this case and 8.9 is that when the TT Team found a gap between targets and reality, it proactively established a Stage Gate mechanism rather than making compromises under pressure. A Stage Gate serves three functions:

blocks.zh: 資訊透明：關鍵數據、風險、成就、選項 → 呈現給更高層管理
blocks.en: Information transparency: key data, risks, achievements and options → presented to higher management

blocks.zh: 專業導入：引入公司其他部門的SME，獲得對新技術的外部視角
blocks.en: Expertise input: bringing in SMEs from other parts of the company to provide an outside perspective on the new technology

blocks.zh: 決策對齊：在推進前獲得所有相關方的明確授權
blocks.en: Decision alignment: obtaining explicit authorization from all relevant parties before proceeding

blocks.zh: 比喻：登山的審慎回頭
blocks.en: Analogy: Turning Back with Prudence on a Mountain Climb

blocks.zh: 登山隊在接近頂峰時遭遇惡劣天氣。沒有規紀的隊伍繼續前進，往往以悲劇告終。有紀律的隊伍在Stage Gate（預設的高度點）重新評估：繼續、等待還是下撤？加一次Mock Run（水批次訓練）就像先模擬登頂再真正出發——多花時間，但確保首次嘗試就成功。
blocks.en: A climbing team meets bad weather near the summit. An undisciplined team presses on and often ends in tragedy. A disciplined team reassesses at a Stage Gate (a preset altitude point): continue, wait or descend? Adding a Mock Run (water batch training) is like rehearsing the summit climb before actually setting out: it takes more time but ensures success on the first attempt.

blocks.zh: Mock Run（Water Batch）的價值
blocks.en: The Value of a Mock Run (Water Batch)

blocks.zh: 在進入PPQ前執行Mock Run（水批次）是一個低風險的訓練工具，讓操作人員在真正使用產品批次前，充分練習新設備與新製程的操作。本案例明確說明這個額外步驟帶來了「首次成功」（right first time）的結果。對於複雜的新技術，Mock Run是降低PPQ失敗風險的有效投資。
blocks.en: Running a Mock Run (water batch) before PPQ is a low-risk training tool that lets operators practice thoroughly with the new equipment and new process before using real product batches. This case states explicitly that the additional step produced a "right first time" result. For complex new technology, a Mock Run is an effective investment in reducing the risk of PPQ failure.

blocks.zh: 在TT計畫中預設Stage Gate決策節點：
blocks.en: Preset Stage Gate decision points in the TT plan:

blocks.zh: Engineering Run完成後（Readiness Stage Gate）：Go/No-Go for PQ
blocks.en: After the Engineering Run is complete (Readiness Stage Gate): Go/No-Go for PQ

blocks.zh: 複雜製程考慮加入Mock Run作為強制前置步驟
blocks.en: For complex processes, consider making a Mock Run a mandatory preceding step

blocks.zh: Stage Gate會議應包含：數據回顧、風險清單更新、外部SME意見、明確的下一步授權
blocks.en: Stage Gate meetings should include: data review, updated risk list, external SME input and explicit authorization for the next steps

blocks.zh: 特別是面對新技術或公司內部expertise有限的製程，主動提議引入外部SME，而非依靠TT Team獨自解決。
blocks.en: Especially for new technology or processes where in-house expertise is limited, proactively propose bringing in external SMEs rather than relying on the TT Team to solve problems alone.

blocks.zh: Stage Gate不是阻礙TT進度的官僚流程，而是在複雜或高風險TT中保護所有相關方的決策工具。案例最後的結論很有力：「雖然多花了時間，但Stage Gate機制避免了PQ失敗或Handover失敗，實際上節省了時間。」這個邏輯值得在與委託方的時程討論中直接引用。
blocks.en: A Stage Gate is not a bureaucratic process that slows the TT; it is a decision tool that protects all parties in a complex or high-risk TT. The closing conclusion of the case is powerful: "Although it took more time, the Stage Gate mechanism avoided a PQ failure or Handover failure and actually saved time." This logic is worth quoting directly in schedule discussions with the sending party.

blocks.zh: 移交階段對成功商業化啟動的重要性
blocks.en: Importance of the Handover Stage for a Successful Commercial Launch

blocks.zh: 核心教訓：TT成功 ≠ 商業化成功，知識轉移必須到達操作員層級
blocks.en: Key Lesson: TT Success ≠ Commercialization Success; Knowledge Transfer Must Reach the Operator Level

blocks.zh: 本案例是TR65最具警示意義的案例：TT在所有技術指標上都成功了——PQ通過、首批商業批次完美——但商業化啟動後立即陷入危機。根本原因：
blocks.en: This is the most cautionary case in TR65. The TT succeeded on every technical measure (PQ passed, first commercial batches perfect), yet fell into crisis right after commercial launch. The root causes:

blocks.zh: TT Team的知識留在TT Team身上，沒有真正轉移到常規生產操作員
blocks.en: The TT Team's knowledge stayed with the TT Team and was never truly transferred to routine production operators

blocks.zh: TT Team被分散（人員調職、顧問合約終止），知識隨之消散
blocks.en: The TT Team was dispersed (staff reassigned, consulting contracts ended) and the knowledge dissipated with them

blocks.zh: SOP、批次記錄和訓練在TT Team監督下足夠用，但在無監督情況下不足以支撐獨立操作
blocks.en: SOPs, batch records and training were adequate under TT Team supervision, but not enough to support independent operation without it

blocks.zh: 比喻：拆鷹架的時機
blocks.en: Analogy: When to Take Down the Scaffolding

blocks.zh: 建築完工後急著拆鷹架，但工人還沒學會如何自行維護這棟建築。TT Team就是鷹架——在施工期間不可或缺，但必須在操作員真正具備獨立能力後才能撤離。「批次通過」不等於「操作員已具備獨立能力」。
blocks.en: The scaffolding is taken down in a hurry once the building is complete, but the workers have not yet learned how to maintain the building themselves. The TT Team is the scaffolding: indispensable during construction, but it must be removed only after the operators are truly capable of working independently. "Batch passed" does not mean "operators are independently capable".

blocks.zh: Handover Checklist：知識是否真正轉移到操作員？
blocks.en: Handover Checklist: Has Knowledge Truly Been Transferred to Operators?

blocks.zh: 應在Handover前評估以下問題：
blocks.en: The following questions should be assessed before Handover:

blocks.zh: 操作員是否能在沒有TT Team監督下，獨立設定和操作新設備？
blocks.en: Can operators set up and run the new equipment independently, without TT Team supervision?

blocks.zh: SOP和批次記錄是否充分詳細，足以在沒有「現場教練」時指引操作？
blocks.en: Are SOPs and batch records detailed enough to guide operations without an "on-site coach"?

blocks.zh: 操作員訓練的評估方式（考試？實操？模擬批次？）是否能驗證真正的能力？
blocks.en: Does the method used to assess operator training (written test? hands-on? simulated batch?) verify genuine competence?

blocks.zh: 對於新技術，是否有Vendor的訓練材料被整合進內部SOP？
blocks.en: For new technology, has the vendor's training material been integrated into internal SOPs?

blocks.zh: 在Handover Stage設計「操作員獨立能力驗證」機制：
blocks.en: Design a mechanism for "verifying operators' independent capability" at the Handover stage:

blocks.zh: 在TT Team全面撤出前，安排2-3個「無監督批次」觀察操作員的獨立執行能力
blocks.en: Before the TT Team fully withdraws, arrange 2-3 "unsupervised batches" to observe operators' independent execution

blocks.zh: 操作員訓練應包含設備異常處理（故障排除）的情境訓練，而不只是正常操作流程
blocks.en: Operator training should include scenario-based training in equipment abnormality handling (troubleshooting), not only the normal operating procedure

blocks.zh: 建立「知識留存計畫」：TT Team成員在轉任其他職位前，必須完成知識文件化清單
blocks.en: Establish a "knowledge retention plan": before moving to other roles, TT Team members must complete a knowledge documentation checklist

blocks.zh: 對新設備，要求設備供應商提供或協助建立操作訓練教材（Training Guide）
blocks.en: For new equipment, require the equipment supplier to provide or help create operator training material (Training Guide)

blocks.zh: Handover是TR65最容易被低估的階段。「TT成功」的定義應包含：常規生產操作員能夠在無TT Team監督下，穩定、重複地執行製程。如果操作員還需要TT Team「在旁邊」才能順利生產，Handover就尚未完成。用「TR65 Reference Guide approach」在KT階段識別所有關鍵知識要素，並確保這些要素都被轉移到SOP和訓練材料中。
blocks.en: Handover is the most easily underestimated stage in TR65. The definition of "TT success" should include: routine production operators can execute the process stably and repeatably without TT Team supervision. If operators still need the TT Team "standing beside them" to produce smoothly, Handover is not yet complete. Use the "TR65 Reference Guide approach" to identify all critical knowledge elements at the KT stage and make sure they are all transferred into SOPs and training materials.

blocks.zh: Cross-Case Summary & Comparison Matrix — 跨案例總結與比較矩陣
blocks.en: Cross-Case Summary & Comparison Matrix

blocks.zh: 跨案例關鍵洞察 — 繁體中文總結
blocks.en: Key Cross-Case Insights — Commentary

blocks.zh: 五個反覆出現的成功因素
blocks.en: Five Recurring Success Factors

blocks.zh: 治理架構（8.1、8.11）：正式的指導委員會、Stage Gate、溝通計畫是TT在複雜條件下保持方向的關鍵
blocks.en: Governance structure (8.1, 8.11): a formal steering committee, Stage Gates and a communication plan are the key to keeping a TT on course under complex conditions

blocks.zh: 功能對稱的團隊（8.2）：委託方與接收方的TT Team職能必須對應，缺任何一方的職能都會造成知識移轉的盲區
blocks.en: Functionally symmetrical teams (8.2): the TT Team functions of the sending and receiving parties must correspond; a missing function on either side creates a blind spot in knowledge transfer

blocks.zh: 製程就緒度不可妥協（8.9 vs. 8.11）：在Engineering run次優時強行推進PQ，最終損失的時間遠多於事先做好準備
blocks.en: Process readiness is non-negotiable (8.9 vs. 8.11): forcing PQ ahead when the engineering run is suboptimal ultimately loses far more time than preparing properly beforehand

blocks.zh: 知識必須到達最終使用者（8.12）：TT成功的標準是操作員的獨立能力，而非TT Team的技術成就
blocks.en: Knowledge must reach the end user (8.12): the standard of TT success is operators' independent capability, not the technical achievements of the TT Team

blocks.zh: 既有知識的槓桿（8.5、8.10）：成熟CMO和有TT經驗的MAH，能將過去的失敗和成功轉化為可複用的工具、模板和評估框架
blocks.en: Leveraging existing knowledge (8.5, 8.10): a mature CMO and an MAH with TT experience can turn past failures and successes into reusable tools, templates and assessment frameworks

blocks.zh: 三個最常被忽略的風險
blocks.en: Three Most Commonly Overlooked Risks

blocks.zh: 內部TT的低估（8.3）：「同公司、同製程」的假設導致Due Diligence被跳過；內部TT的失敗率不低於外部TT
blocks.en: Underestimating internal TTs (8.3): the assumption of "same company, same process" leads to due diligence being skipped; internal TTs fail at no lower a rate than external TTs

blocks.zh: 文件所有權（8.8）：在合約談判時未確認方法、批次記錄的所有權，導致後續TT執行困難
blocks.en: Document ownership (8.8): failing to confirm ownership of methods and batch records during contract negotiation made later TT execution difficult

blocks.zh: Handover的表面成功（8.12）：PQ通過、PPQ完美，不等於商業化已準備就緒；操作員的真實能力才是Handover的最終判斷標準
blocks.en: Superficial success of Handover (8.12): a passed PQ and a perfect PPQ do not mean commercialization is ready; operators' real capability is the final criterion for Handover

blocks.zh: CDMO Receiving Site Master Lessons — 承接端綜合行動清單
blocks.en: CDMO Receiving Site Master Lessons

blocks.zh: 要求共同建立TT Charter（含變更管理流程）
blocks.en: Require joint establishment of the TT Charter (including the change management process)

blocks.zh: 確認委託方TT Team的職能完整性
blocks.en: Confirm the functional completeness of the sending party's TT Team

blocks.zh: 執行初步Process Fit Assessment
blocks.en: Perform a preliminary Process Fit Assessment

blocks.zh: 識別所有目標市場的法規複雜性
blocks.en: Identify the regulatory complexity of all target markets

blocks.zh: 確認文件所有權與資本投入責任
blocks.en: Confirm document ownership and capital investment responsibilities

blocks.zh: 執行詳細差距評估（Gap & Risk Assessment）
blocks.en: Perform a detailed Gap & Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 建立詳細、真實的時程（以法規複雜性為依據）
blocks.en: Build a detailed, realistic timeline (based on regulatory complexity)

blocks.zh: 設定Stage Gate標準（含PQ就緒度判斷準則）
blocks.en: Set Stage Gate criteria (including PQ readiness criteria)

blocks.zh: 建立TT Risk Tracking工具
blocks.en: Establish a TT Risk Tracking tool

blocks.zh: 使用KT Playbook、Questionnaire、Checklist
blocks.en: Use the KT Playbook, Questionnaire and Checklist

blocks.zh: 安排委託方SME到場捕捉隱性知識
blocks.en: Arrange for the sending party's SMEs to be on site to capture tacit knowledge

blocks.zh: 更新Process Fit Assessment（含實際產率數據）
blocks.en: Update the Process Fit Assessment (including actual yield data)

blocks.zh: 建立中央變更管控系統
blocks.en: Establish a central change control system

blocks.zh: 堅持PQ就緒度標準，不因供應壓力妥協
blocks.en: Hold to the PQ readiness criteria and do not compromise under supply pressure

blocks.zh: 對新技術考慮加入Mock Run
blocks.en: Consider adding a Mock Run for new technology

blocks.zh: Stage Gate決策需記錄並獲得明確授權
blocks.en: Document Stage Gate decisions and obtain explicit authorization

blocks.zh: 驗證操作員的獨立執行能力（非監督狀態下）
blocks.en: Verify operators' independent execution capability (in an unsupervised state)

blocks.zh: 更新SOP和批次記錄至足以自主操作的詳細程度
blocks.en: Update SOPs and batch records to a level of detail sufficient for autonomous operation

blocks.zh: 執行TT知識文件化清單後，TT Team方可解散
blocks.en: Disband the TT Team only after the TT knowledge documentation checklist is complete

blocks.zh: 建立TT Lessons Learned，歸入知識庫
blocks.en: Compile TT Lessons Learned and file them in the knowledge base

blocks.zh: 思考練習：對照你的下一個TT
blocks.en: Exercise: Check Against Your Next TT

blocks.zh: 選擇你即將參與或正在進行的一個TT，用以下12個案例的視角逐一自我評估：
blocks.en: Choose a TT you are about to join or are currently running, and assess it against each of the following questions, drawing on the 12 cases:

blocks.zh: 我們有正式的TT Charter和治理架構嗎？（8.1）
blocks.en: Do we have a formal TT Charter and governance structure? (8.1)

blocks.zh: 委託方的TT Team是否具備所有必要職能？（8.2）
blocks.en: Does the sending party's TT Team have all the necessary functions? (8.2)

blocks.zh: 我們是否因為「這個TT很簡單」而跳過了Due Diligence？（8.3）
blocks.en: Have we skipped due diligence because "this TT is simple"? (8.3)

blocks.zh: 我們的時程估算是否考慮了所有法規複雜性？（8.4）
blocks.en: Does our timeline estimate take all regulatory complexity into account? (8.4)

blocks.zh: 我們有結構化的KT Playbook嗎？（8.5）
blocks.en: Do we have a structured KT Playbook? (8.5)

blocks.zh: 我們執行了兩階段的Process Fit Assessment嗎？（8.6）
blocks.en: Have we performed the two-stage Process Fit Assessment? (8.6)

blocks.zh: 商業化準備活動（ERP設定、備件、操作員訓練）是否已排入計畫？（8.7）
blocks.en: Are the commercialization readiness activities (ERP setup, spare parts, operator training) built into the plan? (8.7)

blocks.zh: 文件所有權和追加資本責任是否已在合約中明確？（8.8）
blocks.en: Are document ownership and additional capital responsibility clear in the contract? (8.8)

blocks.zh: 我們有明確的PQ就緒度標準，且所有相關方都同意嗎？（8.9）
blocks.en: Do we have explicit PQ readiness criteria that all parties agree to? (8.9)

blocks.zh: 我們是否充分利用了既有的TT知識（過去的風險評估、方法、文件）？（8.10）
blocks.en: Are we making full use of existing TT knowledge (past risk assessments, methods, documents)? (8.10)

blocks.zh: 我們的Stage Gate機制是否有明確的Go/No-Go標準？（8.11）
blocks.en: Does our Stage Gate mechanism have explicit Go/No-Go criteria? (8.11)

blocks.zh: 我們的Handover計畫是否包含操作員獨立能力驗證？（8.12）
blocks.en: Does our Handover plan include verification of operators' independent capability? (8.12)

blocks.zh: 如果有任何一個「不確定」，那就是你現在需要解決的TT風險。
blocks.en: If the answer to any of these is "not sure", that is a TT risk you need to resolve now.
